arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.city = 'Rome' AND ml.state = 'GA'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions whose merchant location is Rome, GA, across the whole data period (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31).
assumptions: Rome, Georgia is read as city = 'Rome' with state = 'GA' in merchant_locations, joined on merchant_location_id.
Counts every transaction regardless of fraud label, since the question asks for total transactions.
The period is the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
